name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer
description: Into every generation a slayer is born: one girl in all the world, a chosen one. She alone will wield the strength and skill to fight the vampires, demons, and the forces of darkness; to stop the spread of their evil and the swell of their number. She is the Slayer.

videos.title: Unaired Pilot
videos.overview:
The non-broadcast pilot episode of Buffy the Vampire Slayer was produced by 20th Century Fox in 1996 to pitch a series to networks. The twenty-five-and-a-half-minute production was written and directed by Buffy creator Joss Whedon, and was expanded upon and re-shot for the first episode of the series. It is notable for featuring a different actress in the role of Willow, Sunnydale High is Berryman High and a different actor as Principal Flutie.

After having burned down her school gym and been expelled from a school in L.A., Buffy Summers has moved to Sunnydale with her mother. Buffy goes to school for the first time at Sunnydale High and meets new people: Cordelia, Willow, and Xander. Willow is lured by a vampire into a trap. Buffy shows up with Xander and kills all the vampires except one; the surviving vampire reports the incident back to The Master.

videos.title: Academy of Television Arts and Sciences Panel Discussion
videos.overview:
On June 18, 2002, The Academy of Television Arts and Sciences proudly hosted "Behind the Scene of Buffy The Vampire Slayer", a panel discussion featuring members of the cast and creative team from the hit series.

In attendance were series creator Joss Whedon; actors Nicholas Brendon, Alyson Hannigan, James Marsters & Michelle Trachtenberg; and Director of Photography Raymond Stella, Production Designer Carey Meyer and Executive Producer Marti Noxon.

Held at the Leonard Goldenson Theatre in North Holywood, California, the Buffy cast and creative team were welcomed by ATAS Chairman Bryce Zabel.

The discussion was moderated by Janet Weeks.

videos.title: First Date
videos.overview: Buffy accepts a dinner invitation from Principal Wood, and tries to figure out his true intentions.

videos.title: Get It Done
videos.overview: Buffy introduces Principal Wood to the rest of the team. He brings an artifact that transports Buffy to see the origin of the Slayer, but the others must face a powerful demon to bring her back.

videos.title: Storyteller
videos.overview: Andrew creates a documentary called "Buffy, Slayer of the Vampyres", a record of the current situation in Sunnydale to show to future generations. But Buffy needs to tear him away from his filmmaking, because the Seal of Danzalthar is active and Andrew may hold the key to closing it before it destroys the town.

videos.title: Lies My Parents Told Me
videos.overview: Robin Wood seeks revenge on Spike for killing his mother nearly 30 years ago, whilst everyone else tries to find out how The First has control over him.

videos.title: Dirty Girls
videos.overview: Faith returns to Sunnydale just as a new villain, Caleb, arrives and sends Buffy a message in the form of a badly beaten Potential.

videos.title: Empty Places
videos.overview: After their horrifying loss at the vineyard, the gang turn against Buffy. Meanwhile, Spike and Andrew travel to an old church to question a priest about Caleb.

videos.title: Touched
videos.overview: After being ousted from the group, Buffy tries to figure out how to move forward. Faith and the Potentials plan to interrogate a Bringer for information on Caleb and the First.

videos.title: End of Days
videos.overview: Buffy has a powerful new weapon, but the gang cannot find any information about the origins of the mysterious scythe. The Slayer goes by herself in search of knowledge, and finds a new ally, an old friend, and great danger.

videos.title: Chosen
videos.overview: Buffy conceives a plan to defeat the First once and for all.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 55 wins & 136 nominations total
